activity.planned.title: What the finished screen will do
activity.add.title: Add activity
activity.add.intro: Pick the kind of activity you are about to do.
activity.start.title: Start activity
activity.start.hr.title: Live heart rate
activity.start.hr.body: While the activity runs you see your live heart rate and the zone it falls in, based on your maximum heart rate.
activity.start.gps: Route tracking with GPS is not built yet.
activity.live.maxHr: Zones use your heart rate reserve between {rest} and {value} bpm
activity.gps.title: Live route
activity.gps.intro: Follow your route, pace and distance on a map while you move.
activity.gps.b2: Pace and distance from the phone GPS
activity.gps.b3: Location is only used while an activity runs
activity.details.title: Activity
activity.details.noMap: No route is shown: routes need GPS, which is not built yet.
activity.share.title: Share
activity.share.intro: Turn an activity into an image you can share.
activity.share.b2: Choose what the image shows: route, load, heart rate
activity.share.b3: Hide the start and end of your route
activity.share.b4: Save the image or share it with another app
activity.edit.title: Edit activity
loadx.hero.caption: Load today, scale 0 to 21
loadx.levelNote: Load is calculated from your heart rate zones. It is an own method, not comparable to other apps.
loadx.target.title: Your usual load
loadx.target.how.title: Where this range comes from
loadx.target.how.body: The range is your own average load over the previous days, plus and minus one standard deviation. It needs a few days of data first.
loadx.target.advice.title: Based on your readiness today
loadx.target.advice.lower: Your readiness is low today. A load in the lower half of your usual range fits better.
loadx.target.advice.middle: Your readiness is medium today. A load in the middle of your usual range fits.
loadx.target.advice.upper: Your readiness is high today. You have room for a load in the upper half of your usual range.
loadx.target.advice.unknown: There is no readiness for today yet, so there is no advice.
loadx.target.live: Start an activity to follow your Load for today against this range while you train.
loadx.trends.title: Load trends
loadx.trends.loadDayNote: A load day is a day with a load of 7 or more.
loadx.week.title: Weekly overview
steps.noGoal: You have not set a steps goal. Set one in your profile.
plan.title: Weekly plan
plan.none.title: No plan yet
plan.none.body: Choose how many load days and well-slept nights you aim for each week. Your progress is counted from your own data.
plan.goal.loadDetail: A day counts when its load is {threshold} or higher.
plan.goal.sleepDetail: A night counts when you slept at least your sleep need. {measured} nights measured so far.
plan.setup.title: Set up plan
plan.setup.intro: Set your goals for each week. You can change them at any time.
plan.setup.loadDaysHint: Days with a load of {value} or more
plan.setup.sleepNightsHint: Nights you sleep at least your sleep need
plan.setup.note: The plan is stored on this phone only.
plan.weekly.title: Weekly report
plan.weekly.intro: The last {count} days compared with the 7 days before.
plan.monthly.title: Monthly report
plan.monthly.intro: The last {count} days compared with the 30 days before.
plan.report.tooFew: There are only {count} days of data in this period. A report needs at least {needed}.
plan.report.noPrevious: There are too few days before this period to compare.
plan.report.loadDaysSentence: {count} of {total} days had a load of 7 or more.
plan.report.planSentence: Load days: {loadDone} of {loadTarget}. Nights of enough sleep: {sleepDone} of {sleepTarget}.
plan.report.note: The numbers come from your own days on this phone. This is not medical advice.
profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.stepsGoalHint: Between 1,000 and 50,000. Leave empty for no goal.
profile.streak: {count} days in a row with data
profile.lifetimeNote: Counted over {days} days of data on this phone.
profile.invalid: Check your input: height 80 to 250 cm, weight 25 to 300 kg, steps goal 1,000 to 50,000, birth year from 1900 to this year, maximum heart rate 120 to 230.
profile.ach.streak: {count} days of data in a row
profile.ach.note: Achievements are counted from the days stored on this phone. They have no levels or points.
activity.notFound.title: Activity not found
activity.notFound.body: This workout is not in your data. It may have been recomputed after a sync.
calories.title: Calories
calories.method: Estimated from your heart rate and body profile. Minutes at or above {threshold} bpm use the heart rate equations of Keytel et al. (2005). All other minutes use resting energy from the Mifflin-St Jeor equation (1990). This is an own method, not comparable to other apps, and not a medical measurement.
calories.coverage: Heart rate covered {percent}% of this day. Minutes without heart rate count as rest, so the real value may be higher.
calories.other: Your sex is set to 'other', so OpenHoop uses the average of the equations for men and women.
calories.needsProfile: Calories need your height, weight, sex and birth year (age 18 to 100).
activity.deleted: Activity deleted. You can undo this for {seconds} s.
activity.dayLoadNote: Your day's Load counts every minute of heart rate once, so an activity that overlaps a detected workout does not add the same minutes twice.
activity.form.hint: Times are in 24-hour format, for example 07:30. An end before the start means the next morning, up to 12 hours later.
activity.form.failed: The activity could not be saved.
activity.form.error.date: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
activity.form.error.start: Enter the start time as HH:MM.
activity.form.error.end: Enter the end time as HH:MM.
activity.form.error.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start. An end before the start counts as the next day only within 12 hours.
activity.form.error.future: The activity cannot end in the future.
activity.form.error.tooShort: An activity lasts at least one minute.
activity.form.error.tooLong: An activity lasts at most 24 hours.
activity.add.formIntro: When did you do it? Load and heart rate zones come from the heart rate the band recorded in that time.
activity.add.hrNote: If the band recorded no heart rate in that time, the activity is still saved and shows why there is no Load. After the next sync the values are filled in.
activity.start.saved: When you stop, the session is saved as an activity with its Load and zone split.
activity.live.saved: The session is saved. Its heart rate also counts toward your Load for today.
activity.live.tooShort: The session lasted less than a minute, so it was not saved.
activity.live.target.title: Load today with this session
activity.live.target.noBand: There is no target yet: your usual range needs a few days of Load first.
activity.live.target.noDay: Your usual range is {low} to {high}, but there is no Load for today yet, so progress cannot be shown. The Load above is this session alone.
activity.live.target.body: An estimate: today's Load so far plus the heart rate of this session. It is recalculated after the session.
activity.error.noBand: Activities belong to the data of a band. Pair a band or use the demo band first.
activity.error.invalid: This activity is not valid and was not saved.
activity.details.dayLoad: The heart rate in this activity is part of your day's Load. Each minute is counted once.
activity.details.noHr: The band recorded no heart rate in this time, so there is no Load or zone split. The activity itself is saved.
activity.details.lowCoverage: The band recorded heart rate for less than half of this time, which is too little for a Load.
activity.edit.detectedNote: The band detected this workout. Your changes are stored next to it; the detected record itself is kept.
